summary:
Iteration 14 — Coach-set paylink price. Both backend (7/7 pytest) and frontend UI (all interactions) verified end-to-end.

BACKEND via /app/backend/tests/test_paylink_price.py (7 passed in 77.66s):
  1. Happy path: POST /paylink {price:25} → amount=25; GET /orders/pay/{id} → subtotal=25, total=25, items[0].price=25; proto.price=25 persisted.
  2. Fallback: POST {} on fresh protocol → amount=9.99 (coach default_price).
  3. Regenerate: first POST {price:15}, then POST {price:40} → new order_id, amount=40, old order 404s (deleted), proto.payment_order_id updated to new, proto.price=40.
  4. Paid guard: after admin PATCH order to payment_status=paid, POST {price:50} → 400 'Protocol already paid — cannot regenerate paylink'.
  5. Validation: price=0 and price=-5 both → 400 'Price must be greater than zero'.
  6. Authz: unauth → 403; foreign coach (freshly created via /admin/coaches then demoted) → 404.

FRONTEND via disposable client (testpayui+…@example.com, client 73016ab5…):
  - paylink-price input pre-fills to '9.99' when no prior price.
  - Button label initially '💳 Send payment link' (no payment_order_id).
  - After first send at 25, toast: 'Paylink ready · copied to clipboard · GHP-039 · £25.00'.
  - Reload → pre-fill = '25.00'; button label = '💳 Copy payment link'.
  - Change to 30 → button label switches to '💳 Regenerate link'.
  - Change back to 25 → reverts to '💳 Copy payment link'. Copy-only click does NOT regenerate the order (verified — regeneration only triggered on non-matching price).
  - Type 0 → button not disabled but click triggers destructive toast 'Enter a valid price' (spec allows either).
  - Change to 40, click → toast 'Paylink regenerated · copied · GHP-040 · £40.00' and header re-renders £40.00.
  - Jon Gent's protocol (jongent@hotmail.co.uk) NOT touched.
critical_code_review_comments: coaching_routes.py create_protocol_paylink (~L742-814): logic is correct — override_price=None on protocol with existing unpaid order short-circuits to a copy-return; override_price set triggers delete-old + create-new; paid+override raises 400; price<=0 raises 400 after fallback resolution so fallback path (default 9.99) can't reach the guard. Good.

CoachClientDetail.jsx L245: shouldRegen computed as `!proto.payment_order_id || Math.abs(Number(proto.price||0)-priceNum)>0.001` — matches backend expectation and avoids needless regeneration when price unchanged.
api.js L117 Coaches.createPaylink sends `{price}` only when non-null — correct so that server-side fallback (using proto.price / coach default) works.

Nit — pre-existing (unrelated to this iteration): React hydration warning 'span cannot be a child of option' from CoachClientDetail week selector (~L627). Console noise only; does not affect the paylink feature. Consider replacing decorative <span> inside <option> children with plain text.
Nit — send-paylink-btn is not disabled when price<=0; only a toast is shown on click. Spec explicitly allowed either, but disabling would prevent unnecessary API round-trips.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all 9 UI checks: initial pre-fill, initial label, first-send toast, reload pre-fill, reload label, regenerate label on change, revert label on match, zero-validation toast, regenerate toast)

test_credentials: Coach: coachghp@gmail.com / CoachGHP26 · Admin: admin@ghp-health.com / GHP-Health26. Disposable customer created per test.
seed_data_creation: Disposable customers with prefix testpay+ / testpayui+ created via /auth/register + coaching-request-accept flow. One disposable second coach (testpay+coach2…) created via /admin/coaches for authz test and demoted afterwards. Jon Gent's protocol untouched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Paylink price override feature is fully working. test_paylink_price.py is a self-contained regression suite that creates its own disposable clients and cleans up the extra coach. Two pre-existing observations flagged for main-agent awareness (not blocking): (a) React hydration warning from week-selector option>span in CoachClientDetail.jsx L627; (b) send-paylink-btn could be disabled when price<=0 as a UX polish. Neither should block merge.
